name: message-rewind-safety-dialog
description: Open Messages, reveal an assistant action menu, invoke Rewind, and verify the confirmation safety dialog.

metadata.name: message-rewind-safety-dialog
metadata.description: Open Messages, reveal an assistant action menu, invoke Rewind, and verify the confirmation safety dialog.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((el) => el.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Show messages' && el.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0); if (!button) throw new Error('No visible Show messages control'); button.click(); await sleep(1200); })()

(async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=msg-card-]')]; const card = cards.find((el) => el.querySelector('[data-testid^=msg-speaker-]')?.textContent !== 'You'); if (!card) throw new Error('No assistant message card rendered'); card.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', {bubbles:true, clientX:300, clientY:300})); await sleep(500); })()

assert.failure_message: Rewind action did not render in the assistant action menu

evaluate.expression: (() => { const button = document.querySelector('[data-testid^=msg-rewind-]'); if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error('Rewind action missing'); button.click(); })()

assert.failure_message: Rewind safety dialog did not open
